seo.title: EALA Limone sul Garda: Adults-Only Honeymoon Review
seo.description: Adults-only lakeside luxury at Limone sul Garda. Score 86/100, from $550/night. Verdict, suite pick, 7-night plan.

content.verdict: EALA My Lakeside Dream is the second adults-only honeymoon hotel on Lake Garda — a 65-room contemporary luxury hotel directly on the lakeshore at Limone sul Garda, the northwestern town where the limestone cliffs of the lake rise most dramatically and the lemon-grove terraces above the road give the town its name. Opened in 2019 by the Toscolano group, EALA is purpose-built as an adults-only resort: minimum age 16, no families, and architecture (multiple infinity pools, private jetty, lakeside terraces) oriented entirely around adult-couple comfort. The setting is the entire proposition: where Cape of Senses sits 300m above the lake on a hillside, EALA sits at the water — the infinity pool extends to the lake edge, the private jetty allows direct lake swimming and the hotel’s own gozzo boat departs from your feet, and the alpine cliffs rise immediately above. The spa is the second proposition — 1,500m² over two floors, indoor pool, multiple saunas, thermal experiences, and a couples-only suite with private hot tub. The dining is good (Senso Restaurant, Mediterranean tasting menu) but not Michelin-ambitious. The honeymoon move is one of the Junior Suite Lake View rooms (the lakeside wing rooms have the best views and the closest jetty access), 4–5 nights, with the hotel’s gozzo boat for one day and an excursion to the Dolomites (1h drive). Caveats: Limone village is touristy in summer (cliff-edge town, lots of day-trippers from the ferry); the hotel’s lakeside position means traffic noise from the SS45 coastal road for some rooms (request lake-facing on a higher floor); and the architecture is contemporary, not historic Italian.
content.best_room: A Junior Suite Lake View in the lakeside wing (Floor 4 or 5, lake-facing, with private terrace and view to the alpine cliffs across the water) is the honeymoon room. For full splurge, the Sky Suite with private rooftop pool. Avoid road-facing standard rooms.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Arrival and Senso dinner
itinerary_7_nights.description: Fly Verona (VRN) or Bergamo (BGY) — 1h 30min chauffeur to Limone. Check-in to your Junior Suite Lake View, welcome cocktails at the lakeside pool. Dinner at Senso.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Spa and Limone lemon groves
itinerary_7_nights.description: Morning at the spa — sauna, indoor pool, couples’ treatment. Lunch on the lakeside terrace. Afternoon walk into Limone village and the historic Limonaia di Pra dela Fam.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Private boat day
itinerary_7_nights.description: Hotel’s gozzo from the private jetty — full day cruise south to Garda and Bardolino, lunch at a lakeside trattoria. Sunset back at the jetty.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Dolomites day trip
itinerary_7_nights.description: 1h drive north into the southern Dolomites — Madonna di Campiglio or the Brenta Dolomites. Lunch at a rifugio. Return for dinner at Senso.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Sirmione ferry day
itinerary_7_nights.description: Ferry from Limone (2h south on the lake) — Sirmione’s Grotte di Catullo, lunch at Risorgimento, return ferry. Evening at the pool.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Slow lake day
itinerary_7_nights.description: Morning at the spa. Lunch by the lakeside infinity pool. Afternoon at the lakeside on a lounger. Final dinner with paired wines.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Slow departure
itinerary_7_nights.description: Final breakfast on the suite terrace, last swim in the lake from the private jetty, drive back to Verona airport.

caveats: Limone village is touristy in summer — day-trippers from the lake ferries flood the centre 11am–4pm. The hotel’s private grounds are the antidote.
Lakeside road (SS45) runs immediately behind the property — request a lake-facing room on Floor 3 or above to avoid road noise.
Contemporary architecture, not historic. For Liberty-villa atmosphere, choose Villa Cortine or Villa Feltrinelli instead.

faqs.question: Good for honeymooners?
faqs.answer: Yes — the second-best pure honeymoon hotel on Lake Garda for adults-only couples, alongside Cape of Senses. The lakeside jetty and private boat access are the differentiator.

faqs.question: Best time to visit?
faqs.answer: May, June, and September are ideal. July–August busy but workable (still adults-only). Closed late November to mid-March.

faqs.question: Book in advance?
faqs.answer: Junior Suite Lake View and Sky Suite for May–Sept: 6–9 months ahead. Standard rooms: 3–4 months.

faqs.question: Adults-only?
faqs.answer: Yes — minimum age 16. No children allowed.

faqs.question: Best room type?
faqs.answer: Junior Suite Lake View, Floor 4 or 5, lakeside wing. For full splurge, Sky Suite with rooftop pool.

faqs.question: How to get there?
faqs.answer: Verona Villafranca (VRN) 1h 30min by car. Bergamo (BGY) 1h 30min. Milan Malpensa (MXP) 2h 30min. Hotel chauffeur from any.
